feat: simplify consumable catalog to paper type + category + list (#66)

* feat: simplify consumable catalog and paper-type dictionary

Reshape paper types to identifier/name/status with seeded catalog rows,
slim categories to name/slug, and drop print/spec fields from consumables.

* fix: sync legacy paper-type columns on create and update

Keep key/display_name/enabled populated so inserts remain valid while the
simplified identifier/name/status API is the source of truth.

* chore: regenerate management client for simplified consumables

Refresh generated TypeScript models for paper types, categories, and
consumable create/update payloads after the catalog simplification.

* feat: simplify consumable UI into paper types, categories, and list

Move platform consumables to an independent menu with three pages, drop
print/spec fields from the shared form, and keep App Studio selection-only
paper types.

* fix: remap consumable paper_type_ids across dictionary reseeding

Capture and restore consumable paper-type links when replacing free-form
paper types with the seeded identifier catalog.
